title: An evaluation case's public manifest (evaluation component design v0.2, sections 2 and 5)
description: What a model-controlled run starts from, and a commitment to how it is scored. The oracle itself lives in the private repository; only its content hash is here.

task.description: What a model arm is asked to do, sent verbatim as its first message (a raw arm needs it). Hashed with the manifest, so a changed prompt is a changed case.
